content: GBAutomation adopts full-tree trace attribution as the standard level of observability detail. Every agent runtime must emit the complete Langfuse observation tree (CHAIN/SPAN/TOOL/GENERATION linked by parentObservationId) with resolved model, usageDetails (incl. cache reads), tool names + args, and structured repo/slug/branch tags. The telemetry-report skill is the canonical consumer and must attribute token spend by tool and by output file type.
